description: Harsh waveshaper that reads the signal as a 32-bit integer and shifts its bits, which turns a smooth voltage into rapid discontinuities

params.text: Sets the shift, -5V to 5V across 31 bits either way; clockwise shifts right, which mostly attenuates, counter-clockwise shifts left, which tears the signal up
Sets the range the signal is expected in, 5V or 10V either side of zero; the input is clamped to it and the output is scaled back to it

inputs.text: Shifts the bits further, added to the Amount knob after the trimpot scales it
